lines.text: Paul tells the believers to be strong in the Lord and put on the full armor of God.
Paul says the believers' struggle is against the spiritual forces of evil, not against flesh and blood.
Paul says to take the shield of faith and the sword of the Spirit, which is the glory of God.
Paul asks for prayer that he will boldly make known the gospel as a watchman in chains.
Paul sends Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant, to tell the believers about Paul and encourage their hearts.
